overview: A Halloween-themed interactive site about the Charro Negro legend, with the original legend, a 2026 TikTok-style retelling, curiosities and a 3D character model, narrated in the visitor's own recorded voice.
features: Read the original Charro Negro legend with a timeline
Follow the 2026 Kevin story as a TikTok live chat
Upload your own voice recording and use it as the narration
Play, pause and stop the narration in each story section
Explore an interactive 3D Charro Negro model with clickable details
